title: Team scoping layer (fail-closed) for models
answers: How does team scoping work for Django models?
Which mixin for a new team-scoped model?
body:
`posthog/models/scoping/` (see README.md there):
- Main-DB models: `root_mixin.py:TeamScopedRootMixin` (extends `RootTeamMixin`), `objects = TeamScopedManager()` from `scoping/manager.py`; raises `TeamScopeError` without team context. save() rewrites child env team to parent.
- Separate-DB products: `product_mixin.py:ProductTeamModel` with plain `team_id` BigIntegerField (no cross-DB FK).
- Context set by: `TeamAndOrgViewSetMixin.initial()` (DRF), `@with_team_scope()` (Celery), `with team_scope(team_id):` (scripts). Outside request: `Model.objects.for_team(id)`. Escape: `.unscoped()`.
- CI: `check-idor-model-coverage.py`; exceptions in `scoping/baseline_unmigrated.txt`.
- Not a full security boundary (`_base_manager`, raw SQL bypass).
